summary: Executed targeted backend + frontend regression for premium trial, first-time dashboard, annual plan pricing, focus personalization, family-member routing, and returning-user onboarding behavior.

minor.issue: Auto-downgrade persistence verification via direct DB mutation was skipped because MONGO_URL/DB_NAME were not available to pytest process in this run. API-level behavior around trial fields was validated, but forced-expiration persistence path needs retest in an environment exposing backend DB vars to tests.

action_items: Re-run the 2 skipped backend tests in an environment where MONGO_URL and DB_NAME are available to pytest so forced trial-expiration downgrade path can be fully verified end-to-end.
Keep test_trial_dashboard_focus_regression.py in regression suite for future premium-trial and focus-routing changes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still very large (>1700 lines), increasing regression risk across auth/subscription/onboarding/focus logic; split into focused modules (auth, onboarding, subscriptions, dashboard, AI) to improve maintainability and RCA speed.

success_rate.backend: 87.5% (14/16 targeted tests passed; 2 skipped due env exposure)

test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used seeded student credentials for returning-user regression. Also used newly generated UI/backend test users.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated test users via /api/auth/register and UI registration during this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested flows validated: new onboarded users get premium_trial + 7 days, premium courses unlock during trial, dashboard first-visit copy/trial payload renders, Premium Annual $199/year appears in API/UI, focus-specific first-course routing works for Alcohol/Opioids/Fentanyl/Stimulants/Gambling/Gaming/Mental Wellness, Supporting a Loved One routes to Professor Bridge + family content, returning seeded user remains Welcome back after onboarding resubmission. Only remaining gap is forced-expiration auto-downgrade persistence test due missing DB env exposure in pytest runtime.
rca of the issue: Skipped-case RCA: tests that simulate expiration require direct DB update of user.trial_end_at. In this execution context, MONGO_URL/DB_NAME were unavailable to pytest process, so expiration simulation could not run. Mitigation: expose backend env vars to test runner (or provide a protected test-only endpoint for subscription test fixtures) and rerun those two tests.
